name: pc.notification-worker-profile.v1
authorityRules: C17 LS-CONTROL-WORK/ROLE-CONTROL-WORKER owns SUB-EVIDENCEEXPORTCOMPLETED-CONTROL_WORK-V1 and publication of NotificationDeliveryRequested. LS-NOTIFICATION/ROLE-NOTIFICATION-WORKER alone owns the two NOTIFICATION subscriptions. These pairs cannot be mixed or inferred from a valid credential, database role or source event.

Initial privileged installation independently pins issuer, signed profile digest, environment, participant, privacy domain, profile/revision, exact workload principal/credential/epoch and workload audience. Signature validation alone is historical integrity, never current workload authentication or effect admission.

The durable admission owner must verify the actual TLS peer with the existing Identity kernel, lock/revalidate participant/privacy/principal/credential epochs and validity, and check the installed profile current state/expiry before and after the atomic operation. No caller-supplied peer, readiness boolean, shared human session or copied admission object substitutes for those owners.

Producer trust, routing profile and KMS installation digests identify separate owners, each requiring its own source, current routing/policy/module, key and retained-ciphertext checks. A profile grants no arbitrary signing, plaintext disclosure, gateway credential, key destruction, user acknowledgement or cursor progress.

The signed receipt key is distinct from the profile issuer and workload transport key. An exact signing-key installation/version and authorized attempt must bind the complete prepared receipt before provider I/O. Retain original request/signature on ambiguous outcomes; never re-sign to create a replacement effect.

Receipt families remain distinct: NotificationOccurrenceReceiptV1 belongs only to LS-NOTIFICATION under its EvidenceExportCompleted subscription; NotificationDeliveryRequestedReceiptV1 belongs only to LS-CONTROL-WORK. The delivery-request subscriber reconciles the already committed occurrence rather than fabricating a second occurrence.

Source inbox acknowledgement, receipt, local operation result, immutable occurrence/payload references and cursor advancement need one genuine atomic durable owner. Replay matches original event ID and data digest; altered content, gaps or UNKNOWN commit stay explicit and cannot advance. Finite source retry/quarantine and the separately governed six-attempt delivery budget remain mandatory owners outside this profile.
